cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've been on the ward all night. I taught you to rest after caring for everyone else; sit down and I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you still notice things when you're tired. Just a drip. Take the sofa; your tray's ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rest first, as I taught you. I'll bring the duvet down and finish airing your room. You don't need another job after that shift.

reason: Make A claimed rest lesson the caring reason to minimize the leak and personally relocate B comfort rather than reveal the full household problem.
